metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the hose in the morning, the step at four, and a line in the book.

yesterday: The hose were looked at and put back.
Thirty shillings is in her apron, over the quarter. She counted it as from anyone.
The box in London is twenty pound and eight, told to the shilling. A share, if the Mayor lets the house alone, sits between Bartholomew and Christmas.
You said the looking was still ahead. She will believe a house when one is bought. Your mother set a pan down.
The thirty shillings are a line of their own, beside the timber and the loan.
